name: glute ham developer sit up and russian twist
description: A sit-up on the glute ham developer ending with a twist. It trains the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lock your feet in the GHD and lie back with arms crossed or hands clasped.
Sit up in a controlled way.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the middle and lower back down.
Alternate the twist side each rep.
